summary: Smoke-tested NutriViva end-to-end: registration, login, 4-step onboarding, profile save, AI plan generation (7 days x 6 meals via gpt-6-luna, ~46s), plan viewer (daily/weekly), meal alternative, weight check-in, mood check-in with hunger=5 tip (snack cetriolo/mandorle shown), supplements and calendar tabs. All core flows working. Compatibility endpoint returned no warning for Chetogenica+massa but this was not explicitly tested in UI.
passed: PUT /api/profile saves onboarding data (medications must be string, not list)
POST /api/plan/alternative returns alternative meal (uses {day, mealKey} payload)
POST /api/checkins/mood requires mood, hunger, energy, digestion, serenity; hunger=5 returns tip
UI: 4-step onboarding completes, lands on /app dashboard
UI: login existing user shows persisted plan with 7 day pills and 6 meal cards
UI: mood check-in with hunger=5 displays mood-tip containing anti-hunger snack suggestion
UI: tabs supplements and calendar render (select-new-diet, btn-change-diet, input-new-duration present)

failed.issue: After clicking btn-finish-onboarding the dashboard shows 'Nessun piano ancora' and a 502 Cloudflare toast appears. The initial plan auto-generation triggered right after onboarding appears to hit a proxy timeout (plan generation takes ~46s). User must click 'Genera il mio piano' manually. The problem statement expected the plan to be generated automatically after onboarding.
failed.evidence: Screenshot /tmp/05_dashboard.png shows Cloudflare 'origin returned invalid or incomplete response' toast; dashboard empty state with Genera button. Direct POST /api/plan/generate works fine (46s).

failed.issue: POST /api/compatibility with {diet:'chetogenica', goals:['massa']} returns {warnings: []} with no warning. Problem statement expects an incompatibility warning for keto + muscle-gain.

action_items: Investigate why post-onboarding automatic plan generation does not complete (Cloudflare 502 toast). Likely frontend fetch timing out before 46s AI call completes, or request is being retried. Consider showing a loading state and increasing client timeout, or triggering generation lazily via the existing 'Genera il mio piano' button.
Review /api/compatibility rule set to ensure chetogenica + massa (or other incompatible combos) yield a warning, as the Onboarding warning depends on it.
